title: Anthropic expands Claude Startups program to court founders and fast-growth firms
dek: Anthropic broadened its Claude Startups initiative, signaling a renewed push to deepen ties with early-stage and fast-growing companies.
body:
Anthropic has expanded its Claude Startups program. The company says the move is aimed at attracting founders and fast-growing companies and is the latest step in Anthropic's efforts to build closer relationships with those firms.

## Why it matters

This expansion is notable because it frames Anthropic’s commercial strategy around direct engagement with startup founders and rapidly scaling companies rather than only large enterprises. Closer ties with startups can shape which teams build products on Anthropic’s models and may influence longer-term customer relationships and developer ecosystems. The announcement positions the program as a strategic priority for the company.

## The details

- Anthropic announced an expansion of its Claude Startups program.
- The company described the expansion as intended to attract founders and fast-growing companies.
- Anthropic framed this move as the latest push to deepen ties with those groups.
- The specific new features, eligibility criteria, pricing, geographic scope, partner list, and rollout timeline were not disclosed in the reporting available.

## What to watch

Look for follow-up announcements from Anthropic with specifics: what benefits the program now includes, how many startups will be admitted, and whether there are pricing or usage changes. Also watch whether competitors or VCs respond with complementary startup programs or partnerships.

Source: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/06/anthropic-claude-startups-program.html)
